description_en: Uploads the certificate and private key for a domain name that has been added to WAF
description_zh: 为已添加的域名配置记录上传证书及私钥信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-certificate --biz-private-key example-string --certificate-name CertName --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCertificate

parameters.help_en: The domain name that has been added to WAF
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The content of the certificate file
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.example: -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY----- DADTPZoOHd9WtZ3UKHJTRgNQmioPQn2bqdKHop+B/dn/4VZL7Jt8zSDGM9sTMThLyvsmLQKBgQCr+ujntC1kN6pGBj2Fw2l/EA/W3rYEce2tyhjgmG7rZ+A/jVE9fld5sQra6ZdwBcQJaiygoIYoaMF2EjRwc0qwHaluq0C15f6ujSoHh2e+D5zdmkTg/3NKNjqNv6xA2gYpinVDzFdZ9Zujxvuh9o4Vqf0YF8bv5UK5G04RtKadOw== -----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
parameters.help_en: The content of the private key file that corresponds to the certificate
parameters.help_zh: 证书对应的私钥文件内容
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

CertificateId.description_en: The certificate record ID that is automatically generated by the system
CertificateId.description_zh: 系统自动生成的证书记录ID
